name: low_vol_compression_long_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, when the 2-minute realized volatility (24 five-second bars) compresses to below 55% of the 30-minute session baseline, institutional TWAP and HFT algorithms have entered a passive, non-directional mode — neither sending large sweeps nor triggering momentum. This creates a coiled-spring microstructure: resting limit orders accumulate on both sides of the book, spreads tighten, and price oscillates within a narrow band. The first macro trigger — FII block order, global index impulse, or news reaction — causes a cascade of stop orders and momentum algos to activate simultaneously, producing a rapid 15-25 spot point expansion. VWAP position at the moment of expansion reveals which side of accumulated demand is larger: if NIFTY is above VWAP when the range expansion bar fires, VWAP-benchmarked buyers are still net accumulators and the move favors upside.

indicators.name: rvol_24
indicators.purpose: 2-minute realized vol (24 bars × 5s). This is the FAST compression detector — chosen because 2 minutes captures the noise floor of NIFTY's microstructure volatility without being so short (e.g., 6 bars = 30s) that a single outlier bar distorts the signal. The original used 30 × 1-min = 30 minutes; we compress drastically because we are trading the immediate 15-120 second expansion, not the 15-60 minute continuation.

indicators.name: rvol_360
indicators.purpose: 30-minute baseline realized vol (360 bars × 5s). This is the SESSION CONTEXT filter — it tells us whether the current 2-minute quiet period is anomalously quiet relative to the last half hour. Chosen at 30 min (not the original's 4h equivalent of 250 × 1-min) because intraday NIFTY vol regime changes frequently; a 4h baseline would include morning vol when comparing afternoon compression, creating false signals.

indicators.name: compression_ratio
indicators.purpose: Ratio of fast vol to baseline. Replaces the original's PERCENTILE_RANK(250) which requires expensive full-window sorting at every bar. The ratio is a direct, stable measure of compression: 1.0 = normal, <0.55 = significantly quieter than the recent session baseline. Threshold of 0.55 calibrated to detect the bottom ~15% of intraday compression episodes on NIFTY.

indicators.name: bar_range
indicators.purpose: 5-second bar range. Used in the range-expansion confirmation — the entry fires only when the expansion bar itself shows a range >1.5x the prior 10-bar (50s) average range. This filters false vol-compression readings where compression was already ending gradually rather than exploding suddenly.

indicators.name: avg_range_10
indicators.purpose: 50-second average bar range (10 bars × 5s). Reference level for the range expansion confirmation. 10 bars is long enough to capture the compressed range regime (not just the last 1-2 bars) but short enough to be locally relevant to the compression period.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.purpose: Session VWAP as directional bias filter. No scaling needed — VWAP is always cumulative from the session open. If NIFTY is above VWAP at the expansion moment, VWAP-benchmarked institutional buyers are still in accumulation mode, tilting the explosive move upward.

indicators.name: ema_20
indicators.purpose: 20-bar (100s, ~1.7 minute) EMA as secondary trend confirmation. Confirming price is above/below EMA_20 alongside VWAP eliminates whipsaw entries where the index is crossing VWAP in a choppy sideways regime. Two filters (VWAP + EMA) both agreeing increases confidence in the directional expansion.

buy_ce.confirmation: All four conditions must be true simultaneously on the same 5-second bar

buy_pe.confirmation: All four conditions must be true simultaneously on the same 5-second bar

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts (~8 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5). If the thesis is correct — a genuine vol expansion driven by accumulated institutional orders — NIFTY should not retrace 8 spot pts within the first 30-60 seconds after the expansion bar. A 4-pt option stop gives the trade room for 1-2 bar hesitation while killing false expansions (which retrace immediately).
exit.target_rationale: 7 option pts (~14 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5). Genuine vol expansions from compression on NIFTY typically produce 15-25 spot pt moves in the first 60-120 seconds. Targeting 14 spot pts captures roughly 60-70% of the lower end of this range, providing 1:1.75 risk-reward while maintaining a realistic hit rate. Targeting the full 25 pts would require holding through the full expansion, increasing false-target risk.

filters.vix_filter: none — this strategy is vol-regime agnostic by design; the compression_ratio itself captures the current vol environment without needing VIX
filters.time_filter: 09:30-15:20 IST; skip first 15 min (09:15-09:30) where open auction distorts vol measurements and rvol_360 baseline is insufficient
filters.volume_filter: implicit — bar_range expansion naturally correlates with volume; explicit volume filter avoided to prevent over-fitting to NIFTY index volume which is noisy at 5s resolution
filters.trend_filter: VWAP + EMA(20) dual confirmation provides session-level and short-term trend alignment
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — volatility clustering is structural in index microstructure; the compression→expansion pattern is driven by institutional TWAP scheduling which is stable

adaptation_notes: Original used 30-bar 1-min realized vol vs 250-bar percentile on individual Nifty50 stocks (stock-specific compression). Converted to the NIFTY index itself with: (1) compressed fast lookback from 30-min to 2-min because we trade the immediate 15-120s expansion not the 15-60 min continuation; (2) baseline changed from 250-bar (4h) to 360-bar (30-min) to capture intraday session regime without mixing morning and afternoon vol regimes; (3) percentile ranking replaced with compression_ratio (rvol_24/rvol_360) for efficiency and stability; (4) range expansion confirmation kept from original (bar_range > 1.5x avg) as it directly identifies the explosive breakout bar; (5) VWAP + EMA dual filter replaces single VWAP condition because NIFTY index VWAP alone is noisy at 5s resolution.
weaknesses: Vol can compress for 5-15 minutes on NIFTY (flat, low-activity period) generating no signals — patience required and session trade count will be low on quiet days
Direction of expansion is uncertain even with VWAP/EMA filter — NIFTY can gap-reverse immediately after range expansion, stopping out before the real move begins
rvol_360 baseline requires 30 minutes of data (360 bars warmup) — strategy cannot trade effectively in the first 30 minutes of the session even after the 09:30 time filter
False compression readings during news event aftermath where vol briefly dips before the second wave — the range_expansion filter mitigates but does not eliminate this
